events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez, born March 14th, 1968. I need a refill of my atorvastatin .
Thanks, one moment while I check.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, atorvastatin twenty milligram tablets, one tablet at night, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Your refill request reference is R Q, five seven four five. It is awaiting prescribing team review.
